da-false-claim.notes: Narrative claim (min of a nonempty upward-closed N-subset is unique) is true; the structural argument via monotone/upward-closed/nonempty is correct.

da-vacuous.evidence: confinement-level-unique.lean:30-36 axiom ConfinementLevel.level_canonical asserts L1.level=L2.level under matching braidIndex/nStrands/q; theorem unique (lines 44-51) is := ConfinementLevel.level_canonical ... i.e. a one-line projection of the axiom.
da-vacuous.notes: At the Lean level the theorem is a near-trivial application of an axiom that already states the conclusion (equal inputs => equal level). The narrative monotone/upward-closed/nonempty argument (the actual content) is NOT formalized; Lean.ConfinementLevel.unique discharges via an assumption equal to its own conclusion. Honest per the docstring (acknowledged as external axiom) but the formal object is essentially self-assuming.

da-circular.evidence: confinement-level-unique.lean:16-36: the axiom encodes 'the level field IS the canonical minimum' and the theorem unique concludes levels are equal — i.e. the axiom assumes precisely the well-definedness/uniqueness the proposition claims.
da-circular.notes: The Lean proof is circular: uniqueness of level is 'proved' from an axiom that posits level is canonically determined by (braidIndex,nStrands,q). The non-circular content (min of upward-closed nonempty set is unique via Nat.find_min) is only in the docstring/.md, not discharged in Lean. Critical because the formal artifact does not actually establish the proposition independently; it asserts it. Mitigation: docstring is transparent that this is a placeholder axiom pending a level_is_min proof field refactor (lines 26-28), so this is an honest stub rather than concealed circularity — still flagged as a fail-grade objection a referee would raise.

da-overclaim.evidence: confinement-level-unique.md:19-22 'Local uniqueness in q: by continuity of shadow prices on the generic locus, l(K,q') is locally constant ... except at the boundary variety where some E(lambda,q)=0.'
da-overclaim.notes: The discrete uniqueness (well-defined min) is sound, but the appended 'local uniqueness in q' clause asserts a continuity/generic-locus analytic result with no proof and no Lean backing — a stronger (analytic, q-dependent) claim grafted onto a finite-set-minimum proposition. The Lean only addresses the discrete equality, not the q-local-constancy. Conclusion stronger than the formalized argument supports.

da-hidden-dof.notes: No free numerical parameter; q is a generic ring element, no calibration introduced.

da-non-sequitur.notes: Narrative steps 1-3 (monotone, upward-closed, nonempty => min exists and unique) follow validly.

da-lean-narrative-divergence.evidence: confinement-level-unique.md:1-17 proves uniqueness from filtration monotonicity/upward-closure/nonemptiness (a Nat.find argument); confinement-level-unique.lean:44-51 instead proves L1.level=L2.level from axiom level_canonical (lines 30-36), which simply postulates that level depends only on (braidIndex,nStrands,q).
da-lean-narrative-divergence.notes: The Lean proves a different, weaker thing than the narrative: the narrative derives uniqueness from structural properties of J^bullet; the Lean assumes canonicality as an axiom and reads off equality. The .md's actual mathematical content (min-of-upward-closed) is absent from the Lean. proof-statement-integrity: the Lean does not derive the .md claim, it assumes an equivalent of it. Also note ts has lean.validation:'not_checked' and the file uses a bare axiom (proof-no-axiom-growth concern).

da-citation-misuse.notes: -- Ref: [manuscript] braids-and-knots/confinement-level (lines 29,43); [manuscript] is the sanctioned no-published-ref form and points to the relevant internal section. No misattribution.

da-definitional-ambiguity.evidence: confinement-level-unique.md:3 l(K,q)=min{l: T_w in J^l(q)} — T_w (the canonical element for K) and the filtration J^bullet(q) are used without restating; line 21 'boundary variety where some E(lambda,q)=0' invokes E(lambda,q) undefined here.
da-definitional-ambiguity.notes: Relies on def:confinement-level and prop:confinement-level-exists (in uses[]) for J^bullet and T_w, acceptable; but E(lambda,q) (shadow-price/spectral function) and 'generic locus' are not pinned. Minor.

da-physical-implausibility.notes: Pure combinatorial/algebraic statement; no physical prediction.

da-reproducibility.notes: No compute/witness backing; proposition is structural.

da-referee-verdict.evidence: da-lean-narrative-divergence fail + da-circular(critical)/da-vacuous(major) warns: Lean discharges uniqueness via axiom level_canonical that postulates the conclusion (lean lines 30-36), not via the narrative min-of-upward-closed argument; plus an unproved analytic 'local uniqueness in q' overclaim (md:19-22).
da-referee-verdict.notes: verdict: major-revisions. referee_argument: 'The discrete uniqueness statement is true and the narrative argument is correct, but the formalization is a self-assuming axiom: ConfinementLevel.unique proves nothing the axiom did not already assert. Either formalize the genuine Nat.find/upward-closed argument (carry level_is_min as a proof field per the docstring TODO) or downgrade the Lean claim. Separately, the appended q-local-constancy clause asserts an unproved continuity-of-shadow-prices result and should be scoped or removed.'
